name_reason: Inverted misnomer vs the verified blit math. Compositor fd2_render_chapter_intro_overlay reads this table @ 0x52647 then 'IMUL EAX,EAX,0x1C8' (multiply by the 0x1C8 working-buffer row pitch) = the ROW (Y) contribution; the companion @ 0x52635 (currently named *_y_row_table) is ADDed directly = the WITHIN-ROW (X/column) contribution. So this table should be *_y_row_table and the companion *_x_column_table. This is a PAIRED SWAP: 0x52647 and 0x52635 must swap names simultaneously in Stage 2 (to avoid a transient name collision, rename the companion first or via a temp). Already flagged on the companion's Ghidra plate as 'queued for a paired rename with the companion @ 0x52647'.
purpose: ROW/Y member of the (X,Y) coordinate pair driving the chapter-intro portrait pose zoom-in/zoom-out animation; flat [3][6] lookup keyed by chapter-intro metadata byte and intro transition state.
logic_summary: Indexed flat as table[chapter_meta_byte*6 + chapter_transition_state] (logical [3][6], stride 6). chapter_meta_byte (0..2) = first byte of the chapter-intro metadata entry (fd2_get_chapter_intro_metadata_entry); chapter_transition_state (0..5) = the live intro variant (data @ 0x5412B). In the static-icon compositor (fd2_render_chapter_intro_overlay @ 0x2D046) the byte is multiplied by the 0x1C8 row pitch and added to the row-major working-buffer base (the Y/row contribution; the companion @ 0x52635 is added directly as the X/within-row offset). In the four animated readers the byte is taken as (value - 0x64) to form the per-frame scroll delta passed as the first arg to fd2_blit_scaled_chapter_pose (10-frame zoom-in for the transition, 11-frame zoom-out for the three menu variants).
element_semantics: One unsigned screen-pixel coordinate per (chapter_meta_byte, chapter_transition_state) cell; stride 1, no scaling on load. Values span the full unsigned byte range (e.g. 0xA3=163, 0x96=150), some exceeding signed-byte range, so the type must stay unsigned.
comment_original_issue: Two factual errors plus a missing caveat: (1) claimed 'Used by 3 reader sites' and listed only 3, but there are 5 readers (missing fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_typeB @ 0x2FF09 and fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_typeC @ 0x3097F); (2) characterized this table as 'the X/column member', which contradicts the verified blit math at 0x2D046 (this table is IMUL'd by the 0x1C8 row pitch = the Y/row member; the companion @ 0x52635 is the X/within-row member); (3) did not mention the known name misnomer / queued paired swap, even though the companion's comment and Ghidra plate already flag it.
